# Fil One Documentation

> Fil One is S3-compatible object storage built for AI agents and data-intensive
> workloads. Stored on the Filecoin network, where storage providers must
> continuously submit cryptographic proofs that they still hold the data they
> committed to store. No egress fees on paid plans, no per-request charges,
> $4.99/TB/month with a $4.99/month minimum.
> Use any S3-compatible SDK or tool — point it at your region's endpoint,
> `https://<region>.s3.fil.one`, with standard Access Key ID / Secret Access Key
> auth. Endpoint, region and key must all refer to the same region.

Critical integration notes for developers:
- CreateBucket and DeleteBucket via the S3 API are region-dependent: supported
  in us-east-1, unavailable in eu-west-1 (use the dashboard there)
- Path-style addressing required: `https://eu-west-1.s3.fil.one/bucket/key`
  (virtual-hosted-style URLs are not supported)
- Access keys are scoped to ONE region and cannot be used against another
- Region, versioning, Object Lock and retention are fixed at bucket creation and
  cannot be changed afterwards (no update-bucket operation)
- Authentication: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) — all S3-compatible SDKs
  handle this automatically
- All buckets are private by default; all data is encrypted at rest and in
  transit (TLS); encryption cannot be disabled. At-rest encryption is done by the
  regional storage gateway and keys are held by the regional operator, NOT by Fil
  One and NOT customer-managed. Do not name a specific cipher or SSE mode.
  SSE-KMS is rejected in us-east-1 (InvalidRequest) and SSE-C is unsupported —
  send no encryption headers at all
- Regions: eu-west-1 Europe (France, default) and us-east-1 US East (Michigan)
- Deletion is permanent and immediate on non-versioned buckets (no recycle bin).
  On versioned buckets a plain delete places a delete marker and prior versions
  are retained and still billed
- CopyObject / server-side copy is confirmed working in us-east-1, including
  copying a specific version onto the current key to promote it (a version
  restore). Not yet confirmed in eu-west-1; download and re-upload as a
  fallback there. The dashboard has no restore/roll-back button either way
- Per-object CIDs, deal IDs, and sealing state are NOT exposed — customers
  cannot independently audit an individual object
- Paid past_due status is READ-ONLY immediately: writes are blocked from the
  moment a payment fails, not after a later deadline; the ~30-day window is
  retrieval-only before the account is disabled
- Trial caps are enforcement thresholds, not allowances: storage reaching 1 TB
  WRITE-LOCKS the account; egress reaching 2 TB DISABLES it entirely. Trial
  egress is a single cumulative budget over the 30 days. Enforced by a
  twice-daily job (~07:00/19:00 UTC), not in real time
- Storage is DECIMAL: 1 TB = 1,000 GB, 1 GB = 1,000,000,000 bytes
- Governance Object Lock has NO grantable bypass permission in the product
- PutObjectRetention (per-object retention) is offered as a key permission and
  is confirmed working in us-east-1 (including Governance-mode bypass); not
  yet confirmed in eu-west-1 — use the bucket-level default retention there
- Legal Hold (GetObjectLegalHold/PutObjectLegalHold) is confirmed working in
  us-east-1, incl. blocking delete while a hold is active; not yet confirmed
  in eu-west-1
- Object/part size limits (5 TB object, 5 GB single-PUT, 10,000 parts, 5 MB min
  part) are standard AWS S3 values, NOT independently confirmed for Fil One
- Bucket names forbid dots (unlike AWS S3); object key max is 1,024 bytes

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.fil.one/quickstart): Create an account, generate
  API keys, and upload your first object — covers App, AWS CLI, Python, and
  JavaScript paths
- [Quickstart - AWS CLI](https://docs.fil.one/quickstart/cli): Full CLI walkthrough
  including named profile setup to avoid repeating --endpoint-url
- [Quickstart - SDK](https://docs.fil.one/quickstart/sdk): Copy-paste examples
  for Python (boto3), JavaScript (AWS SDK v3), and Go to create a bucket, upload,
  and verify

## Storage

- [Buckets](https://docs.fil.one/storage/buckets): Bucket naming rules, how to
  create via dashboard, listing via API, and Filecoin deal lifecycle on deletion
- [Objects](https://docs.fil.one/storage/objects): Upload, download, list, delete,
  and presigned URL generation with code examples for App, AWS CLI, and boto3
- [Multipart Uploads](https://docs.fil.one/storage/multipart-uploads): Required
  above the single-PUT ceiling (standard S3 5 GB, not independently confirmed);
  recommended for > 100 MB. Dashboard uploads are single-PUT; multipart is via
  your own SDK/CLI. No lifecycle rule to auto-abort incomplete uploads
- [Object Lock](https://docs.fil.one/storage/object-lock): WORM retention.
  Opt-in at bucket creation, Governance (default) and Compliance modes, 1 day to
  100 years, no trial-specific cap. NO third-party compliance attestation, NO
  grantable Governance bypass permission in the product. Per-object
  PutObjectRetention and Legal Hold are confirmed working in us-east-1; not yet
  confirmed in eu-west-1. Regulations (SEC 17a-4, FINRA, HIPAA) are illustrative
  use cases, not a certification claim
- [Bucket Intelligence](https://docs.fil.one/bucket-intelligence): EARLY ACCESS,
  allowlisted, free during early access. Turn a bucket into a queryable
  knowledge base. Indexing runs on a 6-hourly cron (NOT upload-triggered).
  Managed models only (Titan Text Embeddings V2, Claude Opus 4.8 via Bedrock).
  sk_rag_ bearer keys authorize only the query endpoint and never expire.
  Types: PDF/txt/md/html/docx/pptx, no OCR. MCP endpoint is NOT built

## Security

- [Account Security](https://docs.fil.one/security/account-security): securing
  the account you sign in with (distinct from API request auth). Sign-in via
  passkeys (primary), Google, GitHub, or email with password; email
  verification is mandatory before the dashboard opens. Opt-in two-factor with
  three factor types: authenticator app (OTP), security key (WebAuthn roaming),
  device biometrics (WebAuthn platform). SMS and email codes are deliberately
  NOT offered. Up to 20 passkeys per account. Single-use recovery codes.
  Removing a factor or passkey, removing all factors, and regenerating a
  recovery code all require a fresh two-factor check (step-up)
- [Authentication](https://docs.fil.one/security/authentication): SigV4 auth
  setup for AWS CLI, Python (boto3), JavaScript (AWS SDK v3), and Go; credential
  best practices including environment variable usage
- [API Keys](https://docs.fil.one/security/api-keys): Creating keys with scoped
  permissions (Read/Write/List/Delete), CreateBucket/DeleteBucket and
  GetBucketVersioning/GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration groups, single-region
  scoping, bucket-level scoping, key expiration, revocation, best practices
- [Encryption](https://docs.fil.one/security/encryption): server-side
  encryption always on by default for all objects; TLS in transit; keys held by
  the regional operator (no customer-managed keys, cipher unconfirmed).
  Client-side encryption is up to you — AWS's S3 Encryption Client exists only
  for Java/.NET/Go/Ruby, NOT boto3/CLI/JS v3

## Billing

- [Trial & Billing](https://docs.fil.one/billing/trial): 30-day free trial with
  1 TB storage (1,000 GB) and 2 TB egress (cumulative); storage cap write-locks,
  egress cap disables the account; trial lifecycle (active → grace → expiry);
  paid past_due is read-only immediately; paid plan $4.99/TB/month, $4.99/month
  minimum, no egress or request fees. Cancellation is via the Stripe portal
- [Pricing](https://docs.fil.one/billing/pricing): $4.99/TB/month (decimal TB,
  1,000 GB) with a $4.99/month minimum; single linear rate plus a floor (no
  first-TB tier); metered twice daily; no egress or per-request charges

## API Reference

- [API Reference Overview](https://docs.fil.one/reference/overview): Base endpoint,
  SigV4 authentication requirement, path-style addressing, and response format
- [S3 Compatibility](https://docs.fil.one/reference/s3-compatibility): Full table
  of supported vs. unsupported S3 operations (GetObject, PutObject, DeleteObject,
  ListObjectsV2, multipart, presigned URLs all supported; bucket policies, lifecycle
  rules, IAM not yet supported); differences from AWS S3
- [Error Reference](https://docs.fil.one/reference/errors): Standard S3 XML error
  format, full table of 4xx and 5xx error codes, and troubleshooting for the most
  common errors (SignatureDoesNotMatch, ServiceUnavailable)

## SDKs & Tools

- [SDKs & Tools Overview](https://docs.fil.one/sdk/overview): Connection parameters
  for all tools (endpoint, region, credentials); recommended tools list including
  rclone, Cyberduck, s3cmd, MinIO Client
- [Python (boto3)](https://docs.fil.one/sdk/python): Full examples for upload,
  download, list, delete, multipart, presigned URLs, and error handling
- [JavaScript (AWS SDK v3)](https://docs.fil.one/sdk/javascript): Full examples
  for Node.js including streaming downloads, pagination, presigned URLs, and
  error handling; requires `forcePathStyle: true`
- [Go (aws-sdk-go-v2)](https://docs.fil.one/sdk/go): Full examples for upload,
  download, paginated listing, presigned URLs, and error handling; requires
  `UsePathStyle: true`

## Optional

The browser console at app.fil.one, one page per console screen. No code
required. Each page below is console-specific; the capability pages (Storage,
Security, Billing) hold the concepts and code samples.

- [App - Dashboard](https://docs.fil.one/app/dashboard): Console home. Quick
  setup checklist, PLAN/STORAGE/EGRESS cards, Usage Trends, Recent Activity.
  Storage is a periodic point-in-time reading (a very recent change may not show
  yet) and egress is a rolling 30-day total, not a calendar month. "Est. monthly
  cost" applies $4.99/TB to the latest reading with the monthly minimum as the
  floor, while the invoice uses AVERAGE storage, so they differ. Recent Activity
  covers bucket-created and key-created; object-level events are not included yet
- [App - Buckets](https://docs.fil.one/app/buckets): Bucket list, create form,
  object browser, upload, object detail, download/share. BUCKET DELETION RUNS
  THROUGH THE S3 API, not the console (trash icon disabled). Name, region,
  versioning, Object Lock and default retention are PERMANENT at creation (no
  update-bucket op). Upload is single-PUT (5 GB ceiling); the Prefix field applies
  to individually-selected files, and folder uploads use their own relative paths
  instead. One object at a time (no bulk actions); the browser shows the first
  ~1,000 entries while the tab count stays accurate; no version restore/promote
  (download and re-upload). Download works on trial; SHARING IS A PAID-PLAN
  FEATURE
- [App - API Keys](https://docs.fil.one/app/api-keys): Key list and create flow.
  Region is REQUIRED and a key is scoped to its own region's endpoint.
  Read/Write/List pre-selected, Delete NOT; finer-grained permissions (retention,
  legal hold, versions) are granted INDIVIDUALLY, so Write alone cannot set
  retention. "Create bucket"/"Delete bucket" unavailable in eu-west-1. Secret
  shown ONCE and never stored. Deletion is the revocation (no disable/rotate).
  "Last Used" and "Status" are placeholder columns reading "Never"/"Active" for
  every key, and expiry is not shown after creation
- [App - Billing](https://docs.fil.one/app/billing): Plan card, current usage,
  payment method, invoice history, pricing panel. A FAILED PAYMENT APPEARS IN THE
  TOP BANNER, NOT THE BADGE (still "Active"), and the account is read-only from
  that moment. Invoice card appears once on a paid plan and lists the 3 most
  recent PAID invoices. Egress figure on trial only. Card details live in the
  Stripe portal, which is also where cancellation happens
- [App - Settings](https://docs.fil.one/app/settings): Profile fields (name <= 200
  chars; company name 2-100; valid email, disposable rejected), notification
  preferences, pointer to Account Security. Changing your email RESETS
  VERIFICATION and re-triggers the verification-screen redirect; Google/GitHub
  sign-ins manage name and email at the provider (company name stays editable);
  the "Email notifications" toggle is COMING SOON and not active yet, so upload
  and storage-limit emails are not sent today. Account deletion is handled by the
  team at support@fil.one
- [App - Support](https://docs.fil.one/app/support): The "Talk to an expert" form
  behind the sidebar Help menu. All fields required, starts empty, four
  categories, ~1 business day response. Replies arrive by email; the console does
  not show a ticket list
- [FAQ](https://docs.fil.one/faq): Common questions on S3 compatibility,
  blockchain/crypto requirements, data residency, deletion behavior, migration
  from AWS S3, backups, durability, and Filecoin data integrity mechanics
- [Limits & Quotas](https://docs.fil.one/limits): Account limits (storage,
  egress, buckets), object size limits (max 5 TB, use multipart above 5 GB),
  API rate limits, and bucket/key naming constraints
